mapper.select: SELECT s.user_card_id, s.base_year_month, s.prev_performance_amount, s.current_performance_amount, s.shared_limit_used FROM user_card_monthly_state s JOIN user_card uc ON uc.user_card_id = s.user_card_id WHERE s.base_year_month BETWEEN #{fromYearMonth} AND #{toYearMonth}

SELECT u.user_card_id, u.benefit_id, u.base_year_month, u.used_amount, u.used_count, b.calc_method FROM user_benefit_usage u JOIN user_card uc ON uc.user_card_id = u.user_card_id JOIN benefit b ON b.benefit_id = u.benefit_id WHERE u.base_year_month BETWEEN #{fromYearMonth} AND #{toYearMonth}

SELECT e.user_card_id, b.benefit_id, DATE_FORMAT(e.payment_date, '%Y-%m') AS base_year_month, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.payment_status <> 'CANCELED' THEN e.discount_amount END), 0) AS discount_amount, COUNT(CASE WHEN e.payment_status <> 'CANCELED' THEN 1 END) AS applied_count, b.use_shared_limit, b.calc_method FROM expense e JOIN user_card uc ON uc.user_card_id = e.user_card_id JOIN benefit b ON b.benefit_id = e.applied_benefit_id WHERE e.payment_date >= #{fromInclusive} AND e.payment_date < #{toExclusive}
GROUP BY e.user_card_id, b.benefit_id, DATE_FORMAT(e.payment_date, '%Y-%m'), b.use_shared_limit, b.calc_method

SELECT e.user_card_id, uc.card_id, DATE_FORMAT(e.payment_date, '%Y-%m') AS base_year_month, e.expense_id, e.amount, e.payment_status, c.category_code AS category_code, p.category_code AS parent_category_code, e.payment_type, e.is_interest_free, e.discount_amount, b.exclude_from_performance FROM expense e JOIN user_card uc ON uc.user_card_id = e.user_card_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = e.category_id LEFT JOIN category p ON p.category_id = c.parent_category_id LEFT JOIN benefit b ON b.benefit_id = e.applied_benefit_id WHERE e.payment_date >= #{fromInclusive} AND e.payment_date < #{toExclusive}
